_README: Label id -> structure name for TotalSegmentator v2's 'headneck_bones_vessels' task, plus the reviewed mapping onto atlas entities.
A KEY, not data: it contains no anatomy and no geometry. Entries with atlas_id null are decisions NOT to map, each with its reason.
source: Wasserthal J et al., TotalSegmentator (Radiology: AI 2023, doi:10.1148/ryai.230024); class map transcribed from totalsegmentator/map_to_binary.py, v2.18.0, Apache-2.0. Task listed in the project README under 'Openly available for any usage (Apache-2.0 license)'.

zygomatic_arch_right.note: The arch is the temporal process of the zygomatic bone plus the zygomatic process of the temporal bone; assigned to the zygomatic bone, which carries most of it.

zygomatic_arch_left.note: The arch is the temporal process of the zygomatic bone plus the zygomatic process of the temporal bone; assigned to the zygomatic bone, which carries most of it.

thyroid_cartilage.note: The atlas has no laryngeal cartilage entity (it carries the laryngeal muscles). Candidate for authoring.

cricoid_cartilage.note: The atlas has no laryngeal cartilage entity. Candidate for authoring.
